_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
12/6  5:50AM-  Let’s Weekend Stratton! Today you’ll be taking turns down 42 trails, of which 30 took on fresh stripes overnight. Alongside, 9 lifts will be spinning at 8:30AM, with no delays detected. Tyrolienne Park officially opens today with 6 features and 1 jump, go check it! The fun-filled weekend has landed with our Passholder Appreciation, our 1st Ikon Stoke event of the season, and the beginning of Kids’ Ski Free Week. You don’t wanna miss this one! Today is going to be electric. See ya out there, Stratton.  

Our mountain operation team has expansion heavy on their minds. Snowmakers and our groomers have been working around the clock to double our trail count for this weekend. Additionally, we’re looking towards the weekend of December 13 & 14 as a potential opening for the Sun Bowl. Stay tuned for more updates!

Safety Tip: Stop in a safe place where others can see you! 

Kid’s Ski Free Week is BACK! Starting today through December 12 skiers & riders under 17 can SKI FREE at Stratton! Whether you are first-timers or mini-pros, a free week of mountain fun is waiting. Don’t miss out on this fantastic week! 

We're kicking off the season right. This weekend, December 5-7, Stratton and Ikon passholders get the full treatment with après sessions, live music at Mid Mountain, fitness classes, and plenty more for the whole crew to enjoy. Check the Pass Holder Appreciation & Ikon Pass Stoke Event page for the complete lineup.

Want to go on an adventure of a lifetime? Well, you're in luck, our Guided Snowmobile Tours are back! Explore Stratton after hours with friends and family on a tour to the summit. Be sure to book your spot now to guarantee your spot.

The Nordic Center is now open for Snowshoeing! Enjoy a peaceful walk through 10km of trails with friends or family. Once more snow lands, we’ll be chewing at the bit to get the Nordic Center up and running! 

First Tracks will be available for First Tracks pass holders today. Please call the First Tracks hotline for the most up-to-date information the day of at 802.297.INFO 

The last day to buy an Ikon pass is December 11. Buy Now before it’s too late! With 60+ destinations worldwide, you can explore winter to its fullest, from backyard missions to bucket list dreams.

Uphill travel is open! You must get a pass from guest services and read the policy online. Please keep in mind that there are designated travel routes with or without snow.

Time to lock in on your winter fun! Enroll in a high-performance adventure this season. This winter, accelerate your ability level through guided seasonal programs and specialty workshops with the Stratton Mountain Sports School. Seasonal Programs are the best way to turn your little one into a lifetime skier or snowboarder, with a strong foundation of skills, in a discipline they enjoy most. Seasonal Programs focus on fun at an early age, followed by specialty disciplines such as freestyle skiing and snowboarding, ski racing, freeriding, and more. These programs are offered for all ages, including adults, so it's never too late to join!

Stay and relish the Green Mountains! Stratton Real Estate is here to help with all your real estate needs. Make your sweet escape a reality.

Reliable cars are the name of the game; that is why we trust Oliver Subaru and Ford. Made for all seasons and all families, check out Oliver Ford and Oliver Subaru for year-round reliability!

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Good Morning,  Skiers and Riders!  This is Laurie with your 5 am snow report for Saturday, December 6th. Remember, the easiest way to get up to date information is on the Ikon Pass app or website.  
It’s a powder day in the Boat! At Mid Mountain, we’ve had 10 new inches of snow in the past 24 hours, with 6 inches falling since the mountain closed yesterday.  
At the Summit, we’ve had 11 new inches of snow in the past 24 hours, with 6 inches falling since the mountain closed yesterday.  
Our Mid mountain base is 19 inches, the temperature is 24 degrees, the winds are 4 miles per hour from the SE, and it's snowing. 
The Summit base is 23 inches, the temperature is 20 degrees, the winds are 5 miles per hour from the NE, and it is snowing. 
The base temperature is 29 degrees.  
We will be skiing and riding on 8 lifts, 13 runs, and 109 acres on powder snow.  
Today is the first day of kids ski free week. From now until December 11th all children under 12 ski free at Steamboat. Grab your kiddos and take advantage of the free skiing while it lasts. Head to steamboat.com/kidsskifree for more info.  
Stay in the know with the Ikon Pass App. Find it in the app store on your mobile device and get lift and trail statuses, conditions updates, and more.  
If you are thinking of exploring outside the ski area boundaries, and don’t know exactly where you are going, don’t go.  
Ski and Ride with Care and we will see you on the mountain!

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
December 6, 6:30 AM
Opening day part two? I think so. Yesterday our open terrain doubled, we now offer 40 trails off 4 lifts with over 160 skiable acres. Plus, Castlerock is officially open for hiking starting 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM, and we've also dropped ropes on Paradise, Ripcord, and Lower Ripcord among others. Please use caution on natural terrain, coverage is extremely thin with exposed elements. Wait, there's more? Super Bravo and Heaven's Gate will begin loading at 8:00 AM this morning, as well as the addition of Gate House Quad and Welcome Mat at 9:00 AM. Groomers have added Lower Organgrinder and Domino Chute to the typical route, totaling 17 groomed trails with a top to bottom route. Base temps will be in the 20s and teens at the summit, with partial clouds during the day. Reminders that Super Bravo and Heaven's Gate terrain continues to be for advanced skiers and riders at this time and please be aware of thin conditions on natural trails.

Mt. Ellen hike park is back open with 20 beautiful features, starting at 10:00 AM until 3:00 PM for passholders. More good news? Uphill travel will open this afternoon on our PM travel route starting at Gate House, check out our Uphill Travel Policy for more info. Looking for beginner-friendly terrain? Head over to Gate House, where you’ll find 6 freshly groomed trails, perfect for warming up those early-season legs. For firm, fast turns in the morning, check out groomers like Jester and Murphy’s Glades, they’ll soften as the day goes on for a smooth ride. Don’t miss out on this exciting new terrain, grab your gear and join us on the mountain!

Ready for more than turns? Join us this afternoon, Dec. 6th for live music with Soul Rebel Project at Castlerock Pub (1:30–4:30 PM). Starting Dec. 6th through Friday Dec. 12th, kids 12 and under ski and ride for free at Sugarbush. Whether your little ones are just starting out or already shredding, this is the perfect time to plan your trip to the mountain. Check out all of our winter events.

Have an Ikon Base Pass? Come ski before 12/25 and earn a voucher for an unrestricted lift ticket for yourself to be used any day here for the rest of the season. Grab up to five of these tickets simply by skiing and riding here before Christmas. Don't miss out on all of our deals including 50% off December lodging through December 26th.

Bonjour Tremblant!

It’s World Cup weekend in Tremblant, and a beautiful winter day is ahead! Today, more than 93 acres of terrain in excellent condition will be available for all skill levels.

Please note that ski-out access is open on both the North and South sides. Many alpine touring trails and the Progression park are also ready to enjoy! Moreover, the Flying Mile and Beauvallon Haut areas are designated for the race and will therefore be reserved for the event.

Come experience skiing at its finest, enjoy the beautiful weather to recharge your energy, and most importantly, cheer on athletes from around the world!

Please also note that, due to ongoing snowmaking, conditions may vary and visibility is reduced in certain areas. We encourage you to exercise extra caution during your runs so you can fully enjoy your day on the mountain safely.

Stay warm and have a wondeful day!

Mountain safety tip of the week: Please observe the signage.

Snow fall is recorded daily at 5 a.m from mid-mountain at North Side (550 m / 1,800 ft). This data, based on 24 hours, provides a picture of on-mountain conditions. Actual accumulation may differ from the official report. Be aware of changing conditions. Lifts and trails exist in a mountain environment and may close due to weather, usage and/or special maintenance.
